title: Acceptance Under Appending a True Proof Bit
statement: For every $m\in\mathbb{N}$, Boolean input word $w$ of length $m+2$, and Boolean proof word $q$ of length $m$, the short-proof PCPP system's acceptance probability on $(w,q)$ equals the odd-weight partial-sum PCPP system's acceptance probability on $(w,q')$, where $q'$ is obtained by appending a final true bit to $q$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean word of length $m+2$
$q$ is a Boolean proof word of length $m$
